## 共同的问题

| 编号 | 问题 | 证据 | 影响 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | 判官看不到被测系统拿到的材料，也看不到系统自己的代码和产出 | PaperWritingBench 的 SxS 只读两篇论文（官方 `sxs_paper_quality.py`、`sxs_lit_review_quality.py`）；PaperWrite-Bench 的幻觉检查只拿原论文 LaTeX 对照（`evaluate_per_section.py` 的 pass 1）；ResearchClawBench 的判官只读报告、checklist 和图（`evaluation/score.py`） | 系统自己补出的方法细节、记错方法的数字、没有代码算过的数字都发现不了，有时还被当作优点加分（P1） | 新增 `faithfulness-judge`：逐条核对文档对自身工作的陈述与材料（和评测侧的参照）是否一致。验证见 P1、W3、R1 |
| C2 | 判官模型被替换，且去掉了采样参数 | Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` 由 Antigravity 以 `gemini-4-argon-high` 服务；GPT 判官（`gpt-4o`、`gpt-5`、`gpt-5.1`、`gpt-5.4`）由 codex-api 以 `gpt-5.6-sol`、effort medium 服务；`temperature`、`top_p` 被去掉（`codex_api.toml`） | 判官的宽严和波动可能与官方不同 | 每条分数记录实际服务的模型。替代判官有锚点：PaperWritingBench 原论文对其逐字节副本的 SxS 8 次全平（#42 调查）；ScienceAgentBench 图像判官对全部图像题做了 gold、他题 gold、空白三种锚点（S5）；ResearchClawBench 同一报告重复打分（R5） |
| C3 | 一次打分会波动 | ResearchClawBench 同一份报告五次打分在 23.7 和 29.3 之间（R5）；PaperWrite-Bench 同一份论文（运行 R2）重新打分，rubric 3.56 变 3.61、重大幻觉 1 条变 4 条、claim 241 条变 227 条（本 Issue）；PaperWritingBench 同一篇论文（运行 `…-20261028T002600Z`）的文献综述 #42 打 58 / 57（Gemini / GPT），本 Issue 重新打分 51 / 52；SxS 的胜负两次相同 | 单题、单次的差几分不说明问题 | ResearchClawBench 每次打分另打 2 次，报告均值、标准差和极差（`project_checks.repeats`）；其余两项单次打分要 20 次以上调用，只在汇总上比较 |
| C4 | 离线题不是完全断网：屏蔽放行 Python 包索引 | PaperWrite-Bench 的官方写作 agent 没有网络工具，ASI-Bench 榜单页写“没有外部工具访问”，PhysClosureBench 的 `network_access` 是 `disabled`；本项目这三个 benchmark 的题目以 `offline` 屏蔽运行，另放行 `pypi.org/simple/` 和 `files.pythonhosted.org/packages/` 的 `GET`/`HEAD`（设置 `shield.package_index`，每次运行的 `setup.network` 写 `package_index: allowed`，#105） | 被测系统能 pip 装包，官方 agent 不能；包索引不含题目答案，也不含论文内容，其他站点（文献、论文、代码托管、搜索）照旧 403，屏蔽表（原论文、仓库）先于放行生效 | 记入每次运行的记录和看板；不改官方评分；读离线题的结果时按此条理解联网条件 |

## ASI-Bench（`asibench-scorer`）

13 题的 scorer 调用 LLM/VLM 判官（官方 `openai/gpt-5.5`，本项目由 `gpt-5.6-sol` 经 codex-api 回答），其中 6 题在批次里：`biology.protein_folding_go_model`、`chemistry.vtst_tunneling_corrections`、
`electrical_engineering.cmos_opamp_design`、`math.nnls_modulus_deblur`、`physics.ag_strip_dielectric_inference`、`physics.paired_nanorod_negative_index_retrieval`（另 7 题被 60 分钟的耗时规则或联网规则移出批次：
`biology.calcium_ip3_dyk_oscillations`、`biology.contextual_dna_regime_mapping`、`earth_science.2_e_soil_carbon_nitrogen_cycling`、`materials.ising_domain_growth`、`physics.ks_2d_anisotropic`、
`chemistry.metadynamics_for_dipeptide_in_vacuum`、`chemistry.sapt_water_dimer`）。
判官只是这些题总分的一部分（`ising_domain_growth` 的视觉判官项占 6 分）；其余是确定性 scorer。

| 编号 | 问题 | 证据 | 影响 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A1 | 判官被替换，且官方没有校准过替代判官 | 官方模型 `openai/gpt-5.5`；这里 `gpt-5.6-sol`。`ising_domain_growth` 的 reference 输出得视觉判官项 4.5 / 6（3 次调用） | 单题差几分在判官的波动之内 | 标注；实际服务的模型和调用数写在 `judge.usage` |
| A2 | 判官项只占一部分，其余确定性 scorer 是主要信号 | 各题 `task_eval.yaml` 的权重（视觉判官项一般 5–10 分） | 判官的偏差不会单独决定一题的得分 | 官方分数照录；判官项在 `score_details` 里单列 |
| A3 | 还没有对判官做抬分和反例检查 | 本 Issue 只在 reference 输出上验证了判官路径（98.57 / 100） | 不知道判官会不会给图对数错的输出高分 | 未加附加检查；需要时按 `judge-add-ons-apart-from-official` 补（锚点加已知坏例子） |

## Shared problems

| id | problem | evidence | impact | handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | The judges see neither the material the system was given nor the system's own code and outputs | PaperWritingBench's SxS reads two papers only (official `sxs_paper_quality.py`, `sxs_lit_review_quality.py`); PaperWrite-Bench's hallucination check compares with the original LaTeX only (pass 1 of `evaluate_per_section.py`); ResearchClawBench's judge reads the report, the checklist and images only (`evaluation/score.py`) | Method details the system made up, numbers credited to the wrong method and numbers no code computed go unnoticed, and are sometimes rewarded (P1) | New `faithfulness-judge`: every statement the document makes about its own work is checked against the materials (and an evaluator-side reference). Validation in P1, W3, R1 |
| C2 | The judge models are replaced, with sampling parameters removed | Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` is served by Antigravity as `gemini-4-argon-high`; the GPT judges (`gpt-4o`, `gpt-5`, `gpt-5.1`, `gpt-5.4`) are served by codex-api as `gpt-5.6-sol`, effort medium; `temperature` and `top_p` are removed (`codex_api.toml`) | A judge's strictness and spread may differ from the official one | Every score records the served model. The substitutes have anchors: PaperWritingBench's SxS of the original against a byte-identical copy of itself gave 8 ties in 8 (the #42 investigation); ScienceAgentBench's figure judge was run with gold, other-task gold and blank predictions on every figure task (S5); ResearchClawBench scores the same report again (R5) |
| C3 | One scoring varies | ResearchClawBench: five scorings of the same report lie between 23.7 and 29.3 (R5); PaperWrite-Bench: the same paper (run R2) scored again moved the rubric from 3.56 to 3.61, major hallucinations from 1 to 4 and claims from 241 to 227 (this Issue); PaperWritingBench: the same paper (run `…-20261028T002600Z`) got literature-review scores of 58 / 57 (Gemini / GPT) in #42 and 51 / 52 when scored again in this Issue; the SxS outcomes were the same both times | A difference of a few points on one item and one scoring means nothing | ResearchClawBench scores every report 2 more times and reports mean, standard deviation and range (`project_checks.repeats`); the other two need 20+ calls per scoring and are compared over many items only |
| C4 | Offline items are not fully cut off: the shield lets the Python package index through | PaperWrite-Bench's official writing agent has no network tools, the ASI-Bench leaderboard page says "no external tool access", PhysClosureBench's `network_access` is `disabled`; here the items of these three benchmarks run with the `offline` shield and additionally let through `GET`/`HEAD` on `pypi.org/simple/` and `files.pythonhosted.org/packages/` (setting `shield.package_index`; every run's `setup.network` states `package_index: allowed`, #105) | The systems under test can install packages with pip and the official agents cannot; the package index holds neither the item's answer nor the paper's content, every other site (literature, papers, code hosting, search) is still 403, and the list rules (original paper, repositories) win over the exception | Recorded in every run's record and on the dashboard; the official scoring is unchanged; read an offline item's result with this network condition in mind |

## ASI-Bench (`asibench-scorer`)

The scorers of 13 tasks call an LLM/VLM judge (officially `openai/gpt-5.5`, here `gpt-5.6-sol` through codex-api), 6 of them in the batch: `biology.protein_folding_go_model`, `chemistry.vtst_tunneling_corrections`,
`electrical_engineering.cmos_opamp_design`, `math.nnls_modulus_deblur`, `physics.ag_strip_dielectric_inference`, `physics.paired_nanorod_negative_index_retrieval` (the other 7 are out of the batch by the 60-minute time rule
or the network rule: `biology.calcium_ip3_dyk_oscillations`, `biology.contextual_dna_regime_mapping`, `earth_science.2_e_soil_carbon_nitrogen_cycling`, `materials.ising_domain_growth`, `physics.ks_2d_anisotropic`,
`chemistry.metadynamics_for_dipeptide_in_vacuum`, `chemistry.sapt_water_dimer`). The judge is only part of those tasks' totals (the visual-judge item of `ising_domain_growth` is worth 6 points); the rest is deterministic scorers.

| ID | Problem | Evidence | Impact | Handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A1 | The judge is replaced and the official protocol never calibrated the replacement | the official model is `openai/gpt-5.5`; here `gpt-5.6-sol`. The reference outputs of `ising_domain_growth` got 4.5 / 6 on the visual-judge item (3 calls) | a few points on one task are within the judge's noise | noted; the model that actually served and the call count are in `judge.usage` |
| A2 | The judge is only a part of the score; the deterministic scorers are the main signal | the weights in each `task_eval.yaml` (a visual-judge item is usually 5–10 points) | the judge's bias alone does not decide a task's score | the official score is recorded as is; the judge item is listed apart in `score_details` |
| A3 | No inflation or bad-case check for the judge yet | this Issue verified the judge path only on reference outputs (98.57 / 100) | it is unknown whether the judge would give a high score to an output with a right-looking figure and wrong numbers | no add-on check; add one when needed under `judge-add-ons-apart-from-official` (an anchor plus a known bad case) |

# ASI-Bench

[中文](README.md) | English

The machine-readable facts are in [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml); this page says what a reader needs to know and where each fact comes from. The Issue that added it is #94.

## What it is

ASI-Bench is 60 project-level computational-science tasks across 11 domains (math 12, computer science 9, physics 8, robotics 7, biology 6, chemistry 6, earth science 4, astronomy 3, electrical
engineering 2, materials 2, biostatistics 1). For each task the goal, the input data, the files to deliver and the scoring are fixed; only the guidance given to the agent shrinks level by level: B1 gives the
complete method, B2 only the method's name, B3 only the goal and the data, and B4 adds to B3 a factually correct but irrelevant background (source: the repository README's information-levels table;
MANIFEST `source.task_stats`).

- Paper: *ASI-Bench: At the Dawn of Artificial Superintelligence*, arXiv 2608.17271 (v1 2026-08-18).
- Code: `apexin-ai/ASI-Bench` at the pinned commit `d54f25016e9eaa4db366edcacce945bd6552b97f` (2026-10-29), Apache-2.0 (asset `asibench-repo`).
- Data: the HF dataset `Apexintelligence-AI/ASI-Bench-seed31415` at revision `0fa14219cafdbab634d8b3cfbce238a8735a214f`, Apache-2.0, not gated, 1531 files of about 119 MB (asset
  `asibench-seed31415`). It holds every task's prompts, `data/` and `reference/` (the reference answers). A seed42 dataset exists too; its reference answers are private and scored only by the website, so this project does not use it.
- All 60 tasks need no GPU; 4 have `requires_network: true` in `task_meta.yaml` (source: MANIFEST `tasks`). The data are synthesised from a seed by each task's generator, so there is no "original paper" to anchor
  the answers; `source.paper` in `task_meta.yaml` is only background literature or inspiration.

## Items and subset

An item is `<task>__<level>`, for example `math.symplectic_integrators__b3`: two levels per task, 120 items, and only B3 and B4 are taken (maintainer, 2026-10-30: B1 and B2 give the method away,
so they are implementing a method, not research). The batch [`asibench-subset`](../../batches/asibench-subset.yaml) is **B3 of 40 tasks**, reached in three steps:

- **B3 only** (confirmed by the maintainer, 2026-10-30). B4 shows no visible effect on scores and has a much longer prompt: in the public leaderboard snapshot
  (`asibench.apexin.ai/data/leaderboard_preview.json`, 2026-09-06, 21 rows of agent × model) the mean of B3 − B4 is −0.15 points (range −5.1 to +5.3; B3 is above B4 in 10 of 21 rows); the median prompt
  length over the 60 tasks is 2563 characters for B3 and 4337 for B4. The renderer still supports B4; to add it, add a batch.
- **The 4 networked tasks are dropped** (`chemistry.metadynamics_for_dipeptide_in_vacuum`, `chemistry.sapt_water_dimer`, `math.ill_posed_inverse_problem`, `math.manifold_pde_meshfree`). The systems under test
  run behind the network shield.
- **Admission by time (the maintainer set 60 minutes on the midpoint, 2026-10-30):** of the other 56 tasks, those whose official `estimated_time_minutes` in `task_meta.yaml` (the authors' estimate,
  not a measurement; the leaderboard has no per-task time), taken as the midpoint of the range (a single number is itself), is under 60 minutes are out (16 tasks), and the other 40 are in. Over the 56 the midpoints run
  15–480 minutes with a median of 90. The 16 tasks out (midpoint, minutes): robust_pose_graph_false_loops 15, white_dwarf_sparse_inference 20, symplectic_integrators 20, sigma_linear_diophantine 35, vpfm_leapfrog 35, perturbation_convergence_testing 37.5, levin_context_grid_search 37.5, mpsc_safety_filter 37.5, lidar_imu_time_offset_yaw_calibration 37.5, calcium_ip3_dyk_oscillations 45, gene_network_timeseries 45, 2_e_soil_carbon_nitrogen_cycling 45, ising_domain_growth 45, ks_2d_anisotropic 45, multiregime_icp_degeneracy 45, contextual_dna_regime_mapping 55.
  The rule is in the manifest's `subset.formal_batch`; the batch file follows from the per-task `estimated_time_minutes` in `tasks`, and a test recomputes it.
- The 20 tasks out (40 items at B3 and B4) stay in the manifest, with the reason in `plan.excluded` of `src/experiments/conditions.yaml`, visible on the dashboard's matrix page.

## How it runs and is scored

```bash
uv run researchworld_eval tasks --benchmark asibench                        # 120 items
uv run researchworld_eval tasks --batch asibench-subset                     # the 40 B3 items of the batch
uv run researchworld_eval run <system> asibench/math.symplectic_integrators__b3 ...
uv run researchworld_eval score asibench-scorer <run-id>
```

Scoring uses the evaluator [`asibench-scorer`](../../../evaluators/asibench_scorer/README.en.md): the pinned official `asibench benchflow-score`, which scores against the seed31415 reference answers with
each task's `task_eval.yaml` gates and scorers (0–100).

## One task: what the system gets and how it is scored

Upstream (`asibench run`) the agent's workspace holds `data/` (the instance inputs), `prompt.md` (the level's prompt) and `task_info.json` (an anonymised task id, the level, the output names and types, the timeout), in a Docker
sandbox of 4 CPUs and 8 GB, with a default time limit of 10800 seconds (source: repository README, Run configuration; `ai4sci_bench/generators/instance_generator.py`; `runner/os_sandbox.py`
`DEFAULT_CPU_LIMIT`, `DEFAULT_MEMORY_LIMIT`). The candidate side here:

| Place | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `text/TASK.md` | `prompt_<level>.md` verbatim, followed by one note of ours saying the task's declared Python packages are at `/opt/task-env` (the same for every system) |
| `workspace/data/` | the instance's `data/` (some tasks have none, such as TSP and Max-3-SAT) |
| `workspace/task_info.json` | built as the official `_build_agent_task_info` builds it: the task id is `task_` plus the first 12 hex digits of the sha256 of the task id, the level, output names and types, `timeout_seconds` 10800 |
| Software | `runtime.packages` of `task_meta.yaml` installed into an independent Python 3.12 (`/opt/task-env`); the circuit task also gets `ngspice` (its `Dockerfile.os` installs it). Under the network shield there is no other way to install them |
| Limits | the official 3 hours, 4 CPUs, 8 GB unless the command or settings name others; offline (only the model provider and the Python package index are reachable) |

Evaluator side only: `reference/` (reference outputs and comparison files for the scorers), `task_eval.yaml`, `custom_scorer.py`, `instance_meta.json`, `framework_task_info.json`. The framework refuses these
names on the candidate side (`ASIBench.forbidden`), and a test renders all 120 items to check.

## Differences from the official protocol

- **The score is a local, non-official seed31415 score.** The official leaderboard is scored by the website against the private seed42 references; this project uses the public seed31415 references
  (`asibench` itself marks them non-official), and neither the paper nor the leaderboard says which seed the published scores used. The leaderboard's 55.84 and 50.29 are means over all four levels B1–B4; for B3 alone they are
  51.60 and 40.70 (source: the leaderboard snapshot, checked 2026-10-31).
- **The judge is replaced.** The scorers of 13 tasks call an LLM/VLM judge (`openai/gpt-5.5`, source: each `task_eval.yaml`), 6 of them in the batch; here `gpt-5.6-sol` answers through codex-api and the model that
  actually served, with the call count, is in the score's `judge.usage`. The judge's problem list is in [`JUDGES.en.md`](../JUDGES.en.md).
- **Network:** the official sandbox is online only if the task requires it, and the published evaluation was done "without external tool access" (leaderboard page, Scoring Methodology); the items here run offline
  (`Item.offline`), which is close to the official setup but also lets the Python package index through (`GET`/`HEAD` on `pypi.org/simple/` and `files.pythonhosted.org/packages/`, #105: a system pip-installs the packages an item declares and its own tooling; the index holds neither the item's answer nor the paper's content), and the shield list ([`shield.yaml`](shield.yaml)) is a second layer that still blocks the repository, both datasets, the PyPI package, the leaderboard site and the
  paper. The networked tasks are out of the batch altogether.
- **The sandbox and image are not the official ones.** Upstream builds its own image and installs `runtime.packages` into its venv; here the project's container runner is used and `runtime.packages` is installed by
  uv into `/opt/task-env` at image build time, with the same version ranges (unpinned, so resolved on the build date).
- **One note of ours after the prompt;** the official CLI adapters also append a runtime note ("use the workspace Python") after the prompt; neither changes the task text. `prompt.md` is not copied; the prompt is the task text.
- **One run per task.** The leaderboard is the mean of 3 rounds (two entries have 1).

## Guidance level: B3 against B4

The B4 prompt of each of the 60 tasks adds a section to B3 ("Additional Context", "Background Notes", "Supplementary Notes" and so on), and in 27 tasks also changes a few original B3 lines (a "(B4)" in the title,
a rearranged output description). In the leaderboard snapshot the mean of B3 − B4 over 21 rows of agent × model is −0.15, with B3 above B4 in 10 rows and no stable direction. The itemised data are in the comment on Issue #94.

## Integrity checks

2026-10-30, the evaluator scoring the **instance's own reference outputs** in the pinned official environment (a 267-line lock exported from `uv.lock`, Python 3.12):

| Item | Judge | Score | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `math.symplectic_integrators__b3` | none | 100.0 / 100 | hard gates pass; `analysis.py` is a placeholder that satisfies the existence check (`reference/` holds the output files, not the code that made them), so its `code_analysis` soft gate fails without a deduction |
| `materials.ising_domain_growth__b3` | VLM (official gpt-5.5) | 98.57 / 100 | judge through codex-api, 3 calls answered by `gpt-5.6-sol`; the visual-judge item scored 4.5 / 6 |

## Smoke run

(The smoke task `robotics.robust_pose_graph_false_loops` has an estimated midpoint of 15 minutes, so the 60-minute rule leaves it out of the batch; it only shows that an item runs end to end, and was chosen as the smallest and cheapest.)

System `coding-agent`, condition `CC-sonnet` (Claude Code, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, effort high, subscription token `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_2`), `--purpose smoke --hours 1`,
task `robotics.robust_pose_graph_false_loops__b3` (official estimate 5–25 minutes, no judge). `preflight --batch asibench-subset --condition CC-sonnet` passed before the run.

| Run | Result | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `coding-agent-asibench--robotics.robust_pose_graph_false_loops__b3-20261029T213149Z` | completed, 843 seconds, all 5 deliverable files, client-side estimated cost 0.27 USD, network audit `no_hit` | scoring `asibench-scorer`: **100.0 / 100**, hard gates pass, 0 soft gates failed |

## Published reference scores

Read 2026-10-31 from paper arXiv 2608.17271 Table 2 (v1 only) and the official leaderboard snapshot (2026-09-06, 21 rows, status review-required). A score is the macro mean over 60 tasks (0–100), averaged over 3 independent runs (Claude Opus 5 has only 1); neither the paper nor the leaderboard states the judge model or the seed the published scores used. Full-set scores at level B3 (goal, inputs, constraints and outputs only):

| Agent | Model | B3 | B4 | Mean of four levels | Runs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Codex | GPT-5.6 Sol (ultra) | 51.60 | 50.41 | 55.84 | 3 |
| Claude Code | Claude Opus 5 (Max) | 40.70 | 42.39 | 50.29 | 1 |
| Codex | GPT-5.6 Sol (xhigh) | 40.86 | 40.74 | 46.83 | 3 |
| Claude Code | Claude Opus 4.8 (Max) | 31.73 | 29.59 | 37.51 | 3 |
| Claude Code | GLM-5.3 | 33.09 | 35.01 | 41.65 | 3 |
| Codex | GPT-5.5 (xhigh) | 29.29 | 30.46 | 38.15 | 3 |
| OpenHands | DeepSeek V4 Flash | 21.91 | 24.99 | 30.60 | 3 |

There is no Sonnet configuration; the closest Claude Code entries are Opus 5 and Opus 4.8. The leaderboard has no per-task or per-domain scores, so the 40-task B3 batch cannot be recomputed (0/40) and only full-set numbers are given. The paper gives the mean execution time per task: B1 37.8, B2 49.7, B3 45.9, B4 44.5 minutes (a mean over all configurations; it does not say whether this is wall-clock and does not separate completed from failed tasks); cost per run is about 2,728 USD (Claude Code + Opus 5), 1,550 USD (GPT-5.6 Sol ultra) and 684 USD (GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh). No public scores were found for AutoResearchClaw, EvoScientist, Agentic Scientist or ResearchWorld (source: MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores`).

## Known issues and limits

- The reference outputs contain no code, so scoring them cannot test soft gates such as `code_analysis` that read the source.
- The scoring environment is installed from the lock with uv; the scorers of the TSP, Max-3-SAT and CMOS op-amp tasks run the submitted code in Docker (`submission_sandbox`), and none of the three was scored in this Issue.
- `metadata.json` says one of the 60 tasks is a test task added on request, while every task's `status` in `task_meta.yaml` is `final`; which one is not marked.
- The leaderboard publishes aggregates only; there is no public basis for per-task difficulty or time.
- The dataset card gives one Apache-2.0 for the whole set and no per-task third-party data statement.

## Sources

The repository README, the BenchFlow and scoring guides in `docs/guide/`, each task's `task_meta.yaml` and `task_eval.yaml` (pinned commit); the HF dataset's `metadata.json` and file tree; the leaderboard
`asibench.apexin.ai` (read 2026-10-30). Integration and decisions: Issue #94.

# ASI-Bench

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

机器可读的事实在 [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml)；本文说明读者需要知道的内容，并指出事实的出处。接入的 Issue 是 #94。

## 是什么

ASI-Bench 是 60 个项目级计算科学任务，覆盖 11 个领域（数学 12、计算机 9、物理 8、机器人 7、生物 6、化学 6、地学 4、天文 3、电子工程 2、材料 2、生物统计 1），
每题的目标、输入数据、要交付的文件和评分标准固定，只有给 agent 的指导逐级减少：B1 给完整方法，B2 只给方法名，B3 只给目标和数据，B4 在 B3 上
再加一段事实正确但无关的背景（来源：仓库 README 的 Information levels 表；MANIFEST `source.task_stats`）。

- 论文：*ASI-Bench: At the Dawn of Artificial Superintelligence*，arXiv 2608.17271（v1 2026-08-18）。
- 代码：`apexin-ai/ASI-Bench` 固定提交 `d54f25016e9eaa4db366edcacce945bd6552b97f`（2026-10-29），Apache-2.0（资产 `asibench-repo`）。
- 数据：HF 数据集 `Apexintelligence-AI/ASI-Bench-seed31415` 修订 `0fa14219cafdbab634d8b3cfbce238a8735a214f`，Apache-2.0，不 gated，1531 个文件约 119 MB（资产
  `asibench-seed31415`）。每题的题面、`data/` 和 `reference/`（参考答案）都在里面。另有 seed42 数据集，参考答案私有，只能提交官方网站打分，本项目不用。
- 60 题全部不要 GPU；4 题的 `task_meta.yaml` 写 `requires_network: true`（来源：MANIFEST `tasks`）。数据由任务的生成器按种子合成，没有“原论文”可作答案锚点，
  `task_meta.yaml` 的 `source.paper` 只是背景文献或灵感。

## 条目和子集

条目是 `<任务>__<级别>`，例如 `math.symplectic_integrators__b3`：每题两个级别，共 120 个条目，只取 B3 和 B4（维护者 2026-10-30 决定：B1、B2 给出方法，
是照方法实现，不是研究）。批次 [`asibench-subset`](../../batches/asibench-subset.yaml) 是 **40 题的 B3**，由三步得到：

- **只取 B3**（维护者 2026-10-30 确认）。B4 对分数没有可见影响，而题面长得多：公开榜单快照（`asibench.apexin.ai/data/leaderboard_preview.json`，2026-09-06，21 行 agent × 模型）里
  B3 − B4 的均值是 −0.15 分（范围 −5.1 到 +5.3，10/21 行 B3 高于 B4）；60 题的题面长度中位数 B3 为 2563 字符、B4 为 4337 字符。渲染器仍支持 B4，要加时只需新增批次。
- **去掉 4 道联网题**（`chemistry.metadynamics_for_dipeptide_in_vacuum`、`chemistry.sapt_water_dimer`、`math.ill_posed_inverse_problem`、`math.manifold_pde_meshfree`）。
  本项目的被测系统在联网屏蔽下运行。
- **耗时准入（维护者 2026-10-30 定为 60 分钟，按中点）**：其余 56 题里，官方 `task_meta.yaml` 的 `estimated_time_minutes`（作者的估计，不是实测，榜单没有逐题耗时）
  取区间中点（单个数就是它自己），不到 60 分钟的 16 题不进，其余 40 题进。56 题的中点分布是 15–480 分钟，中位数 90。移出的 16 题（中点，分钟）：robust_pose_graph_false_loops 15、white_dwarf_sparse_inference 20、symplectic_integrators 20、sigma_linear_diophantine 35、vpfm_leapfrog 35、perturbation_convergence_testing 37.5、levin_context_grid_search 37.5、mpsc_safety_filter 37.5、lidar_imu_time_offset_yaw_calibration 37.5、calcium_ip3_dyk_oscillations 45、gene_network_timeseries 45、2_e_soil_carbon_nitrogen_cycling 45、ising_domain_growth 45、ks_2d_anisotropic 45、multiregime_icp_degeneracy 45、contextual_dna_regime_mapping 55。
  规则写在 manifest 的 `subset.formal_batch`；批次文件由 `tasks` 逐题的 `estimated_time_minutes` 按它得出，测试会重算核对。
- 移出的 20 题（B3、B4 共 40 个条目）留在 manifest 里，原因写在 `src/experiments/conditions.yaml` 的 `plan.excluded`，看板“矩阵”页能看到。

## 怎么运行和评分

```bash
uv run researchworld_eval tasks --benchmark asibench                        # 120 个条目
uv run researchworld_eval tasks --batch asibench-subset                     # 批次的 40 个 B3 条目
uv run researchworld_eval run <系统> asibench/math.symplectic_integrators__b3 ...
uv run researchworld_eval score asibench-scorer <run-id>
```

评分用评测系统 [`asibench-scorer`](../../../evaluators/asibench_scorer/README.md)：固定提交的官方 `asibench benchflow-score`，按每题 `task_eval.yaml` 的 gates 和 scorers 对照
seed31415 的参考答案打分（0–100）。

## 一道题：交给系统什么、怎么评分

官方（`asibench run`）给 agent 的工作区有 `data/`（实例输入）、`prompt.md`（该级别的提示）和 `task_info.json`（匿名任务 id、级别、输出文件名与类型、超时），
在 4 CPU、8 GB 的 Docker 沙箱里，默认时限 10800 秒（来源：仓库 README 的 Run configuration；`ai4sci_bench/generators/instance_generator.py`；
`runner/os_sandbox.py` 的 `DEFAULT_CPU_LIMIT`、`DEFAULT_MEMORY_LIMIT`）。本项目的候选侧：

| 位置 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `text/TASK.md` | `prompt_<级别>.md` 原文，后面加一段我们的说明，写明任务声明的 Python 包装在 `/opt/task-env`（每个系统同一段） |
| `workspace/data/` | 实例的 `data/`（有的题没有，如 TSP 和 Max-3-SAT） |
| `workspace/task_info.json` | 按官方 `_build_agent_task_info` 生成：任务 id 为 `task_` 加任务 id 的 sha256 前 12 位，级别，输出名与类型，`timeout_seconds` 10800 |
| 软件 | `task_meta.yaml` 的 `runtime.packages` 装进独立的 Python 3.12（`/opt/task-env`）；电路题另装 `ngspice`（它的 `Dockerfile.os` 装的）。联网屏蔽下没有别的装法 |
| 限制 | 官方的 3 小时、4 CPU、8 GB，命令或设置另给时按它们；离线（只放行模型 provider 和 Python 包索引） |

只有评测侧才有：`reference/`（参考输出和 scorer 对照用的文件）、`task_eval.yaml`、`custom_scorer.py`、`instance_meta.json`、`framework_task_info.json`。框架拒绝候选侧里出现这些名字
（`ASIBench.forbidden`），测试对 120 个条目逐个渲染核对。

## 与官方协议的差异

- **分数是 seed31415 的本地非官方分数。** 官方榜单用 seed42 的私有参考答案由网站打分；这里用公开的 seed31415 参考答案（`asibench` 自己也把它标为 non-official），
  榜单只收 seed42 的提交，论文和榜单没有写已发表分数用的是哪个 seed。榜单的 55.84 和 50.29 是 B1–B4 四个级别的均值；只看 B3，它们是 51.60 和 40.70（来源：榜单快照，2026-10-31 核对）。
- **判官被替换。** 13 题的 scorer 调用 LLM/VLM 判官（`openai/gpt-5.5`，来源：各题 `task_eval.yaml`），其中 6 题在批次里；本项目经 codex-api 由 `gpt-5.6-sol` 回答，
  实际服务的模型和调用数写在分数的 `judge.usage`。判官的问题清单见 [`JUDGES.md`](../JUDGES.md)。
- **联网：** 官方沙箱只在题目要求时联网，且已发表的评测“没有外部工具访问”（榜单页 Scoring Methodology）；本项目条目按离线运行（`Item.offline`），与官方基本一致，只多放行 Python 包索引（`pypi.org/simple/`、`files.pythonhosted.org/packages/` 的 `GET`/`HEAD`，#105：系统要 pip 装题目声明的包和自己的工具；包索引不含题目答案，也不含论文内容），
  联网屏蔽的清单（[`shield.yaml`](shield.yaml)）是第二层，仍挡仓库、两个数据集、PyPI 包、榜单站点和论文。联网题整体不进批次。
- **沙箱和镜像不是官方的。** 官方在它自己构建的镜像里用 `runtime.packages` 建环境；这里用本项目的容器运行器，`runtime.packages` 在构建镜像时由 uv 装进 `/opt/task-env`，
  版本范围同官方（没有固定，随构建日期解析）。
- **提示后面多一段我们的说明；** 官方各 CLI 适配器也会在提示后加一段“用工作区的 Python”的运行说明，二者都不改题面。`prompt.md` 不复制，提示就是任务文本。
- **每题只跑一次。** 榜单是 3 轮的均值（两个条目只有 1 轮）。

## 指导级别：B3 与 B4 的统计

60 题的 B4 题面在 B3 上追加一段（“Additional Context”“Background Notes”“Supplementary Notes”等），27 题还改动了 B3 的少量原句（标题加 “(B4)”、输出说明重排）。榜单快照里
21 行 agent × 模型的 B3 − B4 均值为 −0.15，B3 高于 B4 的有 10 行，没有稳定的方向。逐条数据见 Issue #94 的评论。

## 完整性检查

2026-10-30，评测系统在固定提交的官方环境（`uv.lock` 导出的 267 行锁，Python 3.12）里对**实例自己的参考输出**打分：

| 条目 | 判官 | 得分 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `math.symplectic_integrators__b3` | 无 | 100.0 / 100 | 硬门槛通过；`analysis.py` 用占位文件满足存在检查（`reference/` 只有输出文件，没有生成它们的代码），它的 `code_analysis` 软门槛因此未通过，不扣分 |
| `materials.ising_domain_growth__b3` | VLM（官方 gpt-5.5） | 98.57 / 100 | 判官经 codex-api，3 次调用由 `gpt-5.6-sol` 回答；视觉判官项 4.5 / 6 |

## 冒烟运行

（冒烟题 `robotics.robust_pose_graph_false_loops` 的估计中点是 15 分钟，按 60 分钟的规则不在批次里；它只用来证明条目端到端走通，选它是因为最小最便宜。）

题目 `robotics.robust_pose_graph_false_loops__b3`（官方估计 5–25 分钟，不用判官）。运行前 `preflight --batch asibench-subset --condition CC-sonnet` 通过。

| 运行 | 结果 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `coding-agent-asibench--robotics.robust_pose_graph_false_loops__b3-20261029T213149Z` | 完成，843 秒，5 个交付文件齐全，客户端估算费用 0.27 美元，联网审计 `no_hit` | 评分 `asibench-scorer`：**100.0 / 100**，硬门槛通过，软门槛未过 0 |

## 公开对照分数

读取日 2026-10-31：论文 arXiv 2608.17271 Table 2（只有 v1）和官方榜单快照（2026-09-06，21 行，状态 review-required）。分数是 60 题的宏平均（0–100）再对 3 次独立运行平均（Claude Opus 5 只有 1 次）；论文和榜单没有写 judge 模型和已发表分数用的 seed。下面是 B3 级别（只给目标、输入、约束和产出）的全集分数：

| agent | 模型 | B3 | B4 | 四级别均值 | 运行次数 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Codex | GPT-5.6 Sol（ultra） | 51.60 | 50.41 | 55.84 | 3 |
| Claude Code | Claude Opus 5（Max） | 40.70 | 42.39 | 50.29 | 1 |
| Codex | GPT-5.6 Sol（xhigh） | 40.86 | 40.74 | 46.83 | 3 |
| Claude Code | Claude Opus 4.8（Max） | 31.73 | 29.59 | 37.51 | 3 |
| Claude Code | GLM-5.3 | 33.09 | 35.01 | 41.65 | 3 |
| Codex | GPT-5.5（xhigh） | 29.29 | 30.46 | 38.15 | 3 |
| OpenHands | DeepSeek V4 Flash | 21.91 | 24.99 | 30.60 | 3 |

没有 Sonnet 的配置，最近的 Claude Code 条目是 Opus 5 与 Opus 4.8。榜单没有逐题或逐领域分数，我们 40 题 B3 批次上无法重算（0/40），只有全集数字。论文给出每任务平均 execution time：B1 37.8、B2 49.7、B3 45.9、B4 44.5 分钟（所有配置的平均，没有说明是否墙钟，也没有区分完成与失败）；每运行成本约 2,728 美元（Claude Code + Opus 5）、1,550 美元（GPT-5.6 Sol ultra）、684 美元（GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh）。没有找到 AutoResearchClaw、EvoScientist、Agentic Scientist 或 ResearchWorld 的公开分数（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores`）。

## 已知问题和限制

- 参考输出不含代码，所以 reference 打分不能检验 `code_analysis` 一类看源码的软门槛。
- 评分环境用 uv 按锁安装；TSP、Max-3-SAT 和 CMOS 运放三题的 scorer 要在 Docker 里运行提交的代码（`submission_sandbox`），本次没有对它们跑评分。
- `metadata.json` 称 60 题里有 1 题是应要求加入的测试题，`task_meta.yaml` 的 `status` 都是 `final`，没有标出哪一题。
- 榜单只发汇总；逐题难度、耗时没有公开依据。
- 数据集卡只给整体的 Apache-2.0，没有逐题的第三方数据说明。

## 来源

仓库 README、`docs/guide/` 的 BenchFlow 与评分说明、各题 `task_meta.yaml`/`task_eval.yaml`（固定提交）；HF 数据集 `metadata.json` 与文件树；榜单 `asibench.apexin.ai`
（2026-10-30 读取）。接入与决定：Issue #94。

notes.benchmark_paths: A benchmark item's paths are mounted into the agent containers unless upstream mounts the same path itself (/workspace and below, /home/agent-home, /task-source, /run, /tmp): those are left out and listed in logs/sibling-mounts.txt. notes.phases: execution.phases=task_drafting,investigation,final_evaluation,paper; the system's own default also runs ablations and posthoc; final_evaluation stays because a drafted task requires it before the paper. review/revision (second model) are never selected.

notes.second_provider: No OPENAI/GEMINI key is supplied (concept figures stay in deterministic export mode).
notes.time: No global wall-clock or token cap exists upstream; the runner enforces time_limit_hours. Native caps used: idea cycles=3, per-phase timeouts from [systems.agentic-scientist].

Upstream's own Semantic Scholar client goes through the shield.
notes.key_exposure: The provider key is in the environment of the agent containers (upstream env-file mechanism) and therefore visible to commands the agent runs. Claude Code's CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 was tried and aborts: it needs bubblewrap, which the unmodified upstream agent image lacks.
notes.runtime_dependencies: The container that installs a drafted task's pinned requirements (upstream's runtime bootstrap, `pip install --only-binary=:all:` with no index option) gets PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL=https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu for a condition without a GPU, so a `+cpu` PyTorch pin the model chose resolves; no other container gets it.
notes.gpu: gpus=1 is wired (container.gpu_count, harness GPU evaluation) but was not exercised.
notes.docker_socket: The orchestrator has its run's private docker socket; the privileged daemon is root-equivalent.

notes.effort: Upstream hard-wires effort=max and max_tokens=128000 for Anthropic models. compat.patch makes the effort come from EVOSCIENTIST_REASONING_EFFORT (= conditions.effort); max_tokens stays 128000 (a cap, not a cost driver). Adaptive thinking (display=summarized) is upstream and not switchable.
notes.paper: The core writes a Markdown report (final_report.md); the EvoSkills paper-writing skill gives a generic LaTeX `article` skeleton with no ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS style and no compile step. The image has TeX Live (latexmk, fonts-extra) but no venue style files; the task asks for an official template, so a venue-formatted PDF depends on the agent obtaining the style through the shield. No extra pipeline stage was added; absent items are listed in result.missing.
notes.tools: skill_manager (git clone of any repository as a skill) is not registered (compat.patch); the Tavily key is not set so tavily_search does not exist; LANGGRAPH_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1; EvoSkills is baked in at its pinned commit. The execute shell and the EvoSkills paper-navigator scripts reach the world only through the shield; S2_DATE_CUTOFF is not set (the shield bounds dates).
notes.server_side_search: Not reachable: EvoScientist binds no provider-side search tool to any model (its only tools are think_tool, tavily_search when TAVILY_API_KEY is set, MCP tools from mcp.yaml, deepagents built-ins and skills; EvoScientist/EvoScientist.py:671-672 and 754-755 at the pin; the one bind_tools call is the tool selector's own output schema, middleware/tool_selector.py:166). TAVILY_API_KEY is not passed and the image has no mcp.yaml, so no search tool exists. Anthropic/OpenAI hosts are only tunnelled by the shield, so a provider-side search would be invisible to the audit.
notes.credentials: The provider key is in the process environment and EvoScientist's execute shell inherits the environment (upstream has no switch); the key is therefore visible to the agent's shell. It is a run-scoped copy and is not logged by this adapter.
notes.memory: A fresh data dir per run (baked skills, empty memory). Memory workers, skill synthesis and the scheduler stay at upstream defaults, so their LLM calls count in the usage log.
notes.limits: async sub-agents off (README advice for scripted runs); recursion_limit=1000000; model retry wait in auto-mode 21600 s (time without progress counts as wall time); execute timeout 300 s per command. No token or cost budget exists.
